events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I work for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components, and I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. I don't know which AI model or system I run on.

If you'd rather talk to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

If you want to go ahead with the reset, I need your employee ID. The reset link is sent to the phone registered on your account.
